main_body: Wooden weapon rack: two side posts, a top beam, a middle crossbar and a base beam, holding four weapons (axe, mace, halberd, sword).
top_band: The top beam shows light tan #d6b37e / #c6904f at rows 9-10, then darker front rows 11-12 (#ac7238, #6b4124). The base beam shows #d6b37e / #c6904f at rows 26-27, then the front at rows 28-29 and below. Each band is only about 2 rows.
evidence: The top beam and base beam each have only a 2-row light edge above a flat darker front, matching the guide's red 'thin seat band 2' and rim-only cases. No distinct front-edge line separates top from front, and there is no eave shadow. The middle crossbar (rows 20-22) is a flat strip with no visible top, and the posts and weapons are drawn flat from the front. The beams do not read as horizontal surfaces seen from above, so the frame fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The wood has about 5 steps (#d6b37e, #c6904f, #ac7238, #8c592f, #6b4124, #40201b) and the metal has 4 grey steps. Outlines are tinted dark brown, with 0% neutral edge pixels. There are no flat 5x5 fills, at 0% coverage. The candidate has 13 colours per tile against 17-20 for the references and 25 distinct colours against 38-40, so it is somewhat lower but still well built and not sticker-like.
